offering_description.value: Prologis owns, develops and leases warehouses and distribution centers to retailers, logistics providers and manufacturers. It also manages real estate investments for institutions, helps tenants equip and power their facilities, and develops data centers.

primary_services.value: Warehouse leasing and property management; build-to-suit development; real estate investment management; warehouse equipment sourcing; energy and charging infrastructure services

customer_segment.value: B2B: Retailers, e-commerce companies, logistics providers, manufacturers, wholesalers, institutional investors and data center customers

end_markets.value: Retail and e-commerce; logistics and parcel delivery; manufacturing; wholesale distribution; data centers

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: Rent for warehouses, distribution centers and related space; commissions or management fees: Managing logistics property investments for institutional investors; service fees: Warehouse setup, equipment sourcing and property services; transaction or usage fees: On-site electricity supplied under power purchase agreements
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; commissions or management fees; service fees; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Acquires land and buildings, develops logistics facilities and leases them to businesses; service provider: Coordinates contractors and equipment suppliers for warehouse tenants and data center customers; financial intermediary: Manages institutional capital invested in logistics properties
value_chain_position.category: asset operator; service provider; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: global: North America, South America, Europe and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: Logistics properties, real estate investment management, warehouse and energy services, and data center development

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: In-house leasing teams, institutional investment teams and national account relationships; agents / brokers: Commercial real estate brokers that represent prospective tenants

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Local zoning and building permits, environmental and workplace safety rules, and REIT tax requirements

notes: The mix of directly sold and partner-supplied warehouse equipment is uncertain.
